# ori-agent

> Go framework (Gio) that provides a complete desktop application shell for agent clients, in the style of the Claude Code desktop "work" view: custom title bar, sidebar tree of projects, sessions and subagents, chat transcript with streamed text and reasoning, tool calls and task lists, slash-command palette, attachments, voice dictation, document preview (Markdown, code, PDF, images), setup and profile pages, French and English UI. The app author writes an Agent (`Run(ctx, *Turn) error`) and configures everything else with one `oriagent.Config`. Module `github.com/sitle/ori-agent`, Go 1.26+, licence EUPL-1.2.

Key facts: call `oriagent.Run(cfg)` once from `main` (it blocks); agents write only through `*oriagent.Turn` methods (goroutine-safe) and must honor `ctx` cancellation; `*oriagent.Ctl` is only valid inside `Command.Run`; UI texts can be translation keys resolved through `Config.Translations`.

## Guides for coding agents

- [Usage skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/skills/ori-agent/SKILL.md): complete guide to building apps with ori-agent - rules, Agent/Turn API, Config reference, commands, pages, translations, common mistakes
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for working on the framework itself

## Examples

- [Minimal app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/examples/minimal/main.go): an echo agent in about forty lines
- [Full demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/examples/anna/main.go): configuration with simulated agent, models, profile, translations
- [Demo data and custom page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/examples/anna/demo.go): projects, transcripts, a translated sidebar page
- [Compiled API examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/example_test.go): agent, subagent, command, page, demo data

## API

- [Go reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/sitle/ori-agent): all exported types and functions
- [Simulated agent source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/sim/sim.go): a full agent using only the public Turn API
- [Built-in UI strings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sitle/ori-agent/main/locales.go): translation keys in French and English
